title: Happy path — Meridian Cloud, PO matches exactly
notes: Clean digital PDF, logo-block template on US Letter. Two lines exactly as PO-2026-0107, no sales tax, PO in a labelled 'PO Number' field.

title: Scanned invoice — Northwind, image-only PDF
notes: Image-only PDF (150 dpi grey scan, 1.5° skew, noise, blur; no text layer). Tax-inclusive layout: 'Total incl. VAT' is the big number, net subtotal and VAT are in small type.

title: Split PO, part 1 — Helios, within remaining balance
notes: Bundled single service line; PO only inside a sentence. German number format (4.000,00 €) and DD.MM.YYYY dates on purpose. Leaves 4,000.00 remaining on PO-2026-0105.

title: Split PO, part 2 — Helios, exceeds remaining balance
notes: Run after EC2a: 8,000.00 billed + 8,000.00 > 12,000.00 PO, so R5 holds it. On a fresh ledger (EC2a not run) it APPROVEs and fully consumes the PO. German number format.

title: Duplicate — Meridian MCS-10398 re-sent in a new layout
notes: Ledger invoice MCS-10398 re-rendered in a plain dunning template with a 'SECOND COPY' stamp and overdue footer; file hash differs from the ledger's. R5 also trips because the original already consumed PO-2026-0106.

title: Price variance — Apex flange 8% above PO
notes: Table-heavy Indian GST tax invoice (IGST 18%, HSN summary, amount in words). Flange rate 486.00 vs PO 450.00 (+8%); PO in the 'Buyer's Order No.' cell; buyer GSTIN also on page.

title: Missing invoice number and PO — Quantum Lab
notes: No invoice number and no PO reference anywhere. Lines exactly as PO-2026-0109 so the PO can be inferred; R8 drafts a vendor email. R10 ignores absent fields, so only R8 fails.

title: Unknown vendor — Silverline Consulting Partners
notes: Minimal Courier invoice from a vendor not in the master. PO-2026-0199 (does not exist) appears only inside the line description.
